newsitem.title: GREECE: MODERN LIVING BLAMED FOR GREEKS' SEXUAL PROBLEMS.
newsitem.headline: MODERN LIVING BLAMED FOR GREEKS' SEXUAL PROBLEMS.

text.p: One in ten Greeks suffers from erection and premature ejaculation problems while one in four Greek women fail to reach orgasm, an epidemiological study by the Hellenic Sexology Association, said on Wednesday.

Casting doubt on the myth of the great Greek lover, the study carried out by the institute of sexology and Patras University, said modern living was largely responsible for the sexual problems of modern Greeks.
The findings showed that 60 percent of sexual problems in males concerned premature ejaculation while 40 percent were erection-related.
The study said 25 percent of Greek women failed to reach orgasm with many reporting diminished sexual desire.
Salonika University professor of obstetrics and gynaecology, Zaharias Papathanasiou, said the causes of most of the problems in men and women were psychological.
